items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: I took Charlie's place in a band... Pat Cook on bass, and what's the name, Charlie, what's the drummer? Charlie Duke.

ctx.x: Is this a picture for Zola?

Yeah, I was in a band. I took Charlie's place in a band. Oh, Charlie Duke? Charlie Duke. Charlie Duke. I took his place. I came in. I was out there at the plaza and heard him out there. Yeah, when I took his place, I came in at that Charlie level. I took his place. Where? Across the length of it, you know, on Canal Boulevard.
